dict.string: Agent Smith uses Apple Events to script and automate other applications on your behalf when you ask it to.
Agent Smith’s worker agent reads and writes files on your Desktop to carry out tasks you assign it.
Agent Smith’s worker agent reads and writes files in your Documents folder to carry out tasks you assign it.
Agent Smith’s worker agent reads and writes files in your Downloads folder to carry out tasks you assign it.
Agent Smith’s worker agent reads and writes files on removable volumes when a task you assign it involves one.
Agent Smith’s worker agent reads and writes files on network volumes when a task you assign it involves one.
